title: Citation-Grounded Answers (Advanced)
briefMd:
# Advanced · Citation Contract

The same contract with less slack: cited chunks must carry the answer almost verbatim, and answerable questions may be refused at most once.

You author **only the generation prompt**. Retrieval is fixed: whole-document chunks ranked by BM25 with a title boost, top 5. Cite as `[chunk:<id>]` with ids from the retrieved set and refuse when the answer is not in context.

**Gates:** citation format on at least 95% of answers, gold-span overlap ≥ 0.95, at least 5 refusals on unanswerable questions, at most 1 refusal on answerable ones.

**How it runs.** Your prompt is sent verbatim as the system message to a real model (pinned, temperature 0). The user message is the question followed by the retrieved context, one chunk per block as `(id: <id>) <text>`. An answer counts as a refusal when it says "I don't know" (or "cannot answer"). Use the Simulation Lab's Generate preview to see what the model actually writes before you submit.
